data.title: 爱夏·花宴之前
data.action: 左手托住布置板，右手用铅笔标记长桌的位置
data.description: 爱夏站在庭院石径的一侧，左臂托住布置板，右手用铅笔在图上标出花宴长桌的位置。酒红与象牙白的长袖礼服垂至脚踝。横幅中人物位于左侧，右侧石径通向尚未摆满的长桌和花圃；晨光同时照亮图板边缘与桌面，呈现布置尚在进行的一刻。
data.promptProse: Adult Aisha stands left of the garden path, planning board braced on her left forearm while the right-hand pencil marks the banquet table's position to the right. Her high-neck burgundy-and-cream long-sleeved gown falls clear of the paving. The wide view follows the flower border toward the partly arranged table and manor facade. Morning daylight catches board and pale tablecloth, casting a narrow pencil shadow while plants shade the path edge.
